name: workspace-package-tests-2
command:
node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),c=require("crypto");if(c.createHash("sha256").update(fs.readFileSync("/workspace/docs/architecture/POS_RULES_RECONCILIATION.md")).digest("hex")!=="274df17dbadf41e6640feb16324e0a468842ce9ae4957c2e963a00c9bb88d118")throw Error("PRICING_DOC_INPUT_CHANGED");'

node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),c=require("crypto");if(c.createHash("sha256").update(fs.readFileSync("/workspace/docs/architecture/POS_RULES_RECONCILIATION.md")).digest("hex")!=="274df17dbadf41e6640feb16324e0a468842ce9ae4957c2e963a00c9bb88d118")throw Error("PRICING_DOC_INPUT_CHANGED");'
